system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
. - Changed my CC today (nov 29) & it says everything is good for Dec 29. Does that mean I will not have my subscription until then? I need music everyday - we are a restaurant.

PREDICTED INTENT: subscription_manage

PRECEDENTS:

[1834441] (similarity 0.60, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: Well my subscription renews in 2 weeks. If Chromecast support is still bad, I'm switching to music.
  spotify replied: Sorry to hear that you feel that way. We'd love to keep helping out. Can you give us more details on what you're experiencing?

[2155140] (similarity 0.55, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: Why does make it so hard to upgrade your subscription?! You'd think it's under "Subscription".
  spotify replied: Hey Melanie, help's here! To upgrade your account, just visit <link> Let us know how it goes

[1889965] (similarity 0.54, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: I'm off Cancelled my subscription. Despite working with , my offline tracks continue to disppear from my library 😔
  spotify replied: Hi, we're sorry you feel that way. Rest assured, we'll pass your comments onto the right team. Let us know if you have other questions

[2034358] (similarity 0.54, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: are you working on an apple watch app, and what is your estimated release date? Might cancel subscription for apple music
  spotify replied: Hey! Check out the official idea and add your vote to let our devs know it's something you'd like to see: <link>

[2598648] (similarity 0.53, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: have been using Spotify for free trial month...why isn't metal and reggae genres updated on Fridays with new releases like everyone else? Been the same for a month now that I've been on.
  spotify replied: Hey there! We don't have any info about this, but we'll pass it on to the relevant folks. Thanks for the heads up ✌️

Draft the reply as JSON.
